definitions.gloss: event; category; item (in sports, competitions, etc.)
definitions.explanation: One of the individual events or categories that make up a sporting competition, examination, or set of activities.

examples.japanese: {好|す}きな{種目|しゅもく}は{水泳|すいえい}だ。
オリンピックには{多|おお}くの{種目|しゅもく}がある。
{運動会|うんどうかい}でどの{種目|しゅもく}に{出|で}るか{迷|まよ}っている。
examples.english: I can't decide which event to enter at the sports day.

notes:
Composed of {種|しゅ} (kind, type) + {目|もく} (item, category). Refers to an individual event or category within a larger competition or program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競技|きょうぎ}{種目|しゅもく}: a competitive event
- {種目|しゅもく}{別|べつ}: by event; per category
- {正式|せいしき}{種目|しゅもく}: an official event

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {競技|きょうぎ}: a sporting event; competition — emphasizes the contest itself, while {種目|しゅもく} emphasizes its place as one category among several
